intro: The internet gave us places to visit.
The metaverse gives us places to enter.
Angel Creations creates virtual worlds and connected digital environments designed around how people explore, interact, communicate, learn, play and experience brands.
From virtual events and immersive education to gaming, digital commerce and virtual product experiences, we approach the metaverse as a creative medium — not simply a piece of technology.
worldStatement: A successful virtual world needs more than a 3D environment.
It needs a reason to exist.
And most importantly, it needs people who want to stay.
Angel brings together storytelling, design, animation, experience design and emerging technology to create environments where digital spaces become experiences.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Worlds
experienceTypes.description: Create persistent or event-based environments where audiences can explore spaces, discover content and interact with others.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Events
experienceTypes.description: Move beyond the limitations of a physical venue. A virtual environment can bring audiences together regardless of location.
experienceTypes.closing: The environment itself becomes part of the event.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Brand Experiences
experienceTypes.description: A brand doesn't always need another website. Sometimes it needs a place. A virtual brand environment can become a destination where people discover products, stories, campaigns and experiences in a more immersive way.

experienceTypes.title: Gaming
experienceTypes.description: Games create participation. Metaverse environments can use game mechanics to make audiences explore rather than simply consume.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Marketplaces
experienceTypes.description: A virtual environment can become a new way to discover and experience products.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Economies
experienceTypes.description: Where appropriate, virtual environments can support systems in which digital participation, ownership, exchange or rewards become part of the experience.
experienceTypes.closing: The creative challenge is not simply creating an economy. It is designing a reason for people to participate in it.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Education
experienceTypes.description: Learning does not have to happen inside a rectangle. Virtual environments can create spaces for:
experienceTypes.closing: The environment becomes part of the lesson.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Workspaces
experienceTypes.description: Distributed teams can use shared virtual environments for:
experienceTypes.closing: The objective is not to recreate an office pixel for pixel. It is to create a better digital space for a particular kind of interaction.

experienceTypes.title: Virtual Product Showcases
experienceTypes.description: Products can be experienced from angles and environments that physical space may not allow.
